title: Tenma Saki — Most Important Wish〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So I substitute this number in and...
Hey! I think I got it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's the matter, Ichi?
Do you need help with something?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I think I'm just too tired to focus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ugh... There's no end to this homework. Winter break's so short, but they gave us so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, right? They split mathematics into geometry and statistics, so it's like double the amount too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why don't we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, here's some sugary brain food for you!
Candy and juice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get it that the brain runs on sugar, but did you really have to bring us this much stuff?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why not? Maybe it'll make your personality sweeter too♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh? What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I get that Honami can really focus on this stuff, but I'm surprised that you can too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, just who do you think I am?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I meant that as a compliment.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's fairly active when it comes to class participation. She asks the teacher a lot of questions too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just so much fun studying with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... You think studying is fun?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I missed out on all of this until recently.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone hates exams and stuff, but to me, they're just another element of school life I've been missing out on!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Portraying exams as a special event, huh? That's so you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You must have missed doing homework together too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When was the last time we met up like this? It must've been during elementary school. Remember when we did our summer assignments together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We all helped each other out with our research projects!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It feels great to be able to do stuff like this with you all again!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And stuff yourself with sweets too, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Speaking of which... Saki's mom always seems to have a lot of snacks and juice ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: D-Don't get the wrong idea...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...? Saki, is your phone ringing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It might just be an app notification... Oh, awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look, guys! I won a healthy food hamper from a New Year's raffle!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is that the health app you installed a while back...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you're still using it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course I am! It helps me stay healthy, so that I never miss a day at school or turn up late for classes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: With that sort of commitment, you should be just fine. Plus, you made that wish when we went to the shrine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wouldn't be so optimistic about her never being late. She takes forever to get her hair and makeup done every morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Or she could just oversleep.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Hey!
Hona...! They're bullying me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh, hey...! Oh, okay. There, there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Watch out! You'll spill everything...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You knocked some cookies onto the floor!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry, I'll eat them! You know, the three-second rule!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's just pick them up so we don't step on them. There's one over there too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Got it! Oh, there's another here... Oww!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oof...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You ran right into each other...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you two okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm not...
Saki, your head felt like a ton of bricks...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? You're one to talk!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems you're both fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Looks like it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, stop laughing at us...!
